rows.behavior: apm.yml lists the 13 rules and 3 skills aim managed, pinned to one jasperhg90/skills commit at or after f0813cd, with targets [claude], and apm.lock.yaml pins the full commit and each file's hash.
rows.fails_when: apm.yml lacks any of the 13 rules or 3 skills, an entry is unpinned or pinned to a commit that does not include the merge of JasperHG90/skills PR 139, targets is not [claude], or apm.lock.yaml is missing or lacks a resolved commit or file hashes

rows.behavior: The installed rules and skills sit at the same paths as under aim, each rule keeps its path scoping and has the pinned upstream body, and each skill equals the pinned upstream folder.
rows.fails_when: any of the 13 rules or 3 skills is missing from .claude/rules/ or .claude/skills/, a rule's paths: list differs from what aim installed (or a rule with none gains one), a rule body differs from the pinned upstream .instructions.md body, or a skill file differs from upstream at the pin

rows.behavior: aim is gone: no aim.toml or aim.lock.toml, no aim: markers or aim header in AGENTS.md, and no file names aim; the guidelines text in AGENTS.md is otherwise unchanged.
rows.fails_when: aim.toml or aim.lock.toml exists, AGENTS.md has an aim: marker or the aim header line, a tracked file outside .loop/ names agent-integrations-manager or aim as the manager, or the guidelines text changed beyond the markers and header

rows.behavior: The installed python-testing rule keeps this repository's additions, through upstream PR 139: the Test tiers section and the measure-before-marking, run-your-own-test and every-tier-runs-somewhere constraints.
rows.fails_when: .claude/rules/python-testing.md lacks the Test tiers heading or any of those three constraint names

rows.behavior: tests/test_rules.py reads the upstream-managed rules from apm.yml, and its docstring and pyproject.toml's ruff comment no longer name aim.
rows.fails_when: tests/test_rules.py reads aim.toml or fails, or it or pyproject.toml names aim
rows.command: uv run pytest tests/test_rules.py tests/test_repo_apm.py -k managed_from_apm -q
